en.role: Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance
en.quote: …Russia will soon attract heightened investor attention as an island of stability.
en.head: Russia entered a severe financial crisis that year.
en.body: Russian shares fell sharply alongside global markets in autumn 2008, and Russia’s GDP contracted by 7.9% in 2009. Kudrin had forecast investor interest “in the near future”; the subsequent crisis undercut his description of Russia as an “island of stability.”
